C0568.title: Man Sentenced for Repeated Malicious Orders and Refund-Only Claims
C0568.summary: A man was convicted of extortion after placing over 2,700 malicious orders against more than 900 merchants over three years, repeatedly requesting refund-only claims, and coercing merchants into paying settlement fees by exploiting platform rules.
